name: Tide Tabs
summary: A bottom tab bar where a drop falls into the tab you pick and it fills with rippling water
about: An app tab bar where the active tab is a small glass of moving water. Pick a tab and a drop falls in with a little splash, the old tab drains, and the new one fills with water that tips in from the side it came from and settles with rolling waves while its label slides out. It works for mobile apps, web apps and small dashboards.
how: Tap or click a tab, or move along the bar with the arrow keys; the pill squishes as you press it.
A drop falls into the new tab and splashes four droplets while the old tab drains away.
Water rises with a springy slosh, its surface tilts and rocks back level, and two waves keep rolling on top.
The icon reacts (the sun spins, the leaf sways, the bars grow), the label slides open and the content cards arrive one by one.
